Academic year term student attended, encoded YYYYT. cip6 Character. 6-digit CIP code program student enrolled term. institution Character. anonymized name institution student attended given term, e.g., "Institution ", "Institution B", etc. level Character. Academic level student end term, e.g., "01 First-Year", "02-Second Year", etc. standing Character. Academic standing reported term, e.g., "Good Standing", "Academic Warning", etc. coop Character. Cooperative education term, possible values "Yes", "." hours_term Numeric. Credit hours earned term. hours_term_attempt Numeric. Credit hours attempted term. hours_cumul Numeric, cumulative credit hours earned. hours_cumul_attempt Numeric. Cumulative credit hours attempted. gpa_term Numeric. Term grade point average. gpa_cumul Numeric. Cumulative grade point average.
